categories.main_business_segments: Shenglan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic connectors and precision components, including consumer electronics connectors, new energy vehicle connectors and components, and optical lenses. Their products serve diverse sectors such as consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, and data communications. The company also engages in related technical services and has expanded into industrial control connectors and high-frequency high-speed connectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies including precision stamping, crimping, injection molding, and precision mold manufacturing. It has developed core capabilities in forward R&D design, ultra-precision mold manufacturing, and intelligent production systems. Key technologies include high-frequency transmission, high-voltage connectors, and high-speed data transmission connectors, with over 400 patents including 40 invention patents. The company emphasizes automation, digital transformation, and lean manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shenglan serves major customers in consumer electronics such as Xiaomi, TCL, Foxconn, Luxshare Precision, Huawei, OPPO, Vivo, Nokia, and Lenovo. In the new energy vehicle sector, it collaborates with leading automakers including BYD, Great Wall Motors, and SAIC-GM-Wuling. For data communications and AI infrastructure, key clients include Inspur, Lenovo, Sugon, and H3C. The company also supplies to emerging sectors like drones (DJI) and new tobacco products (British American Tobacco).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Dongguan and Shaoguan, Guangdong Province. It has overseas subsidiaries and production bases in Hong Kong, Thailand, and the United States, serving both domestic and international markets. Approximately 76% of revenue is from domestic sales and 24% from exports, with growing overseas market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenglan Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of electronic connectors and components. It controls the design, development, and production processes, supplying critical parts to downstream OEMs and EMS providers in consumer electronics, automotive, and data communication industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-frequency high-speed connectors, automotive-grade connectors, and industrial control connectors. It invests heavily in R&D to develop customized solutions, improve product performance, and reduce costs. Key R&D projects include Type-C connectors, waterproof and anti-interference connectors, high-speed data cables, and optical lenses. The company also focuses on automation, digitalization, and expanding production capacity to meet growing market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Shenglan generates revenue primarily through direct product sales of electronic connectors, components, and optical lenses. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to strategic customers and EMS partners. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but the core revenue is from manufacturing and selling physical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global connector giants such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol, and Yazaki, which dominate the high-end market. Domestically, it faces competition from firms like Luxshare Precision, AVIC Optoelectronics, and Yuhua Electronics. Shenglan positions itself as a leading domestic connector manufacturer with strengths in mid-to-high-end products, leveraging local market advantages and policy support to gradually penetrate high-end segments and achieve import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shenglan reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.29 billion, a 3.71% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 102.8 million, up 34.34%. The company has shown steady revenue growth and significant profit improvement, supported by expanding sales in consumer electronics and data communications. Total assets stood at RMB 2.17 billion with net assets of RMB 1.52 billion, reflecting a stable financial position and ongoing investments in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenglan emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced connector solutions tailored to customer needs across multiple industries. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, flexible and automated manufacturing, and deep integration with leading OEMs and EMS providers. The company focuses on delivering customized, high-frequency, high-speed, and automotive-grade connectors that meet stringent quality and certification standards, enabling customers to enhance product performance and reduce costs.
